description: v2.1.0 section 9.1 — typed slot patches applied by QUALIFY to derive a variant offense while preserving its identity (e.g. QUALIFY(embezzlement, occupational_status) -> occupational_embezzlement).

additions.description: Section 9.1: every slot is optional here (unlike OffenseDef.elements, which just happens to also make all slots optional) — a qualifier patches only the slots it adds to, and applying it ANDs the addition onto the base offense's existing expression for that slot (compiler behavior, step 4).
